verdict.rationale: The evidence only thinly shows Workers serving HTTP APIs and WebSocket traffic, via a passing mention of hibernating WebSockets in pricing copy; nothing shows TCP or gRPC serving or a unified no-config multi-protocol model. An old community comment that WebSockets were in beta is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: inbound TCP serving, gRPC serving, documentation that all protocols are served from one deployed service without separate protocol configuration, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve HTTP, TCP, gRPC, and WebSocket traffic from the same deployed service without separate protocol configuration

citations.quote: Cloudflare charges only for compute, not wall time, even during long agent workflows or hibernating WebSockets.
